description: Source-aligned overrides for the seven substantively repaired production records explicitly linked to source-audited corpus records.

records.beginning: The episode begins with Zeus casting Hephaestus from heaven and Hephaestus refusing Olympus.
records.ending: It ends when Dionysus lures Hephaestus with wine and leads him back to Olympus.
records.variantDecision: Baker's throne-and-wine version; the source boundary stops at Hephaestus' arrival in Olympus.
excludedMaterial: A formal restoration of Hephaestus' status.
Material after the truncated source ending.

coreFacts.fact: Zeus casts Hephaestus from heaven.
Hephaestus refuses to return to Olympus and remains at Mount Etna.
Hephaestus sends Hera a golden throne.
The throne's hidden mechanism traps Hera.
Hermes fails to persuade Hephaestus to return.
Dionysus uses wine and leads Hephaestus to Olympus.

records.adaptationValue: Hephaestus Returns to Olympus is a bounded production adaptation aligned to bulk-verified-0010.

records.beginning: The episode begins when Hades seizes Persephone.
records.ending: It ends when Demeter discovers Persephone's girdle beside the River Cyane.
records.variantDecision: Baker's River Cyane and girdle version; Hecate and Helios are excluded.

coreFacts.fact: Hades seizes Persephone.
Hades drives toward the underworld before Demeter can intervene.
Demeter begins searching for Persephone.
Demeter reaches the River Cyane.
Demeter discovers Persephone's dropped girdle.

records.adaptationValue: Demeter Searches the Earth is a bounded production adaptation aligned to bulk-verified-0001.

records.beginning: The episode begins when Hermes leaves a heavy box with Pandora and Epimetheus.
records.ending: It ends when Hope heals those wounded by the escaped evils.
records.variantDecision: Guerber's box version, not a Hesiodic jar or Pandora-creation episode.

coreFacts.fact: Hermes leaves a heavy box with Pandora and Epimetheus.
Pandora raises the lid of the box.
Evils escape from the opened box.
The escaped evils wound Pandora and Epimetheus.
Pandora opens the box again and releases Hope.
Hope heals the wounds and goes out to aid humanity.

records.adaptationValue: Pandora Opens the Box is a bounded production adaptation aligned to bulk-verified-0006.

records.beginning: The episode begins with the oracle concerning Danae's future son.
records.ending: It ends when Zeus descends through the brass tower in a shower of gold and reaches Danae.
records.variantDecision: Berens' brass-tower and golden-rain passage, ending before Perseus' conception or birth.

coreFacts.fact: An oracle tells Acrisius that a future son of Danae will cause his death.
Acrisius imprisons Danae in a brass tower.
Zeus descends through the roof.
Zeus appears as a shower of gold.
The source says Danae becomes Zeus' bride.

records.adaptationValue: Danae and the Golden Rain is a bounded production adaptation aligned to bulk-verified-0022.

records.beginning: The episode begins when Acrisius finds his precautions unavailing.
records.ending: It ends when Dictys conducts Danae and Perseus to the palace on Seriphus.
records.variantDecision: Berens' chest-at-sea and Seriphus rescue passage.

coreFacts.fact: Acrisius finds that his precautions have failed.
Acrisius orders Danae and Perseus placed in a chest.
The chest is thrown into the sea.
The chest strands on Seriphus.
Dictys finds the chest and conducts the occupants to the palace.

records.adaptationValue: Danae and Perseus Cast Adrift is a bounded production adaptation aligned to bulk-verified-0019.

records.beginning: The episode begins when Medusa's slaying is selected as Perseus' heroic deed.
records.ending: It ends when Perseus cuts off Medusa's head and places it in his wallet.
records.variantDecision: Berens' concise guided expedition and beheading; no reflective shield or births from Medusa.

coreFacts.fact: Polydectes selects the slaying of Medusa as a deed of renown for Perseus.
Perseus begins the expedition.
Hermes guides Perseus on the journey.
Athena guides Perseus.
Perseus cuts off Medusa's head and puts it in his wallet.

records.adaptationValue: Perseus Beheads Medusa is a bounded production adaptation aligned to bulk-verified-0004.

records.beginning: The episode begins when Hera sends serpents against the infant Heracles.
records.ending: It ends when Heracles grasps and strangles the serpents.
records.variantDecision: The concise linked infancy episode, without Iphicles, Amphitryon, or an omen interpretation.
excludedMaterial: Alcmene and Amphitryon as scene participants.

coreFacts.fact: Hera sends serpents to destroy the infant Heracles.
The serpents enter Heracles' cradle.
The serpents attack Heracles.
Heracles grasps the serpents.
Heracles strangles and kills the serpents.

records.adaptationValue: Infant Heracles Strangles the Serpents is a bounded production adaptation aligned to bulk-verified-0012.
